10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10276|2846a7fb.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2846a7fb.text: A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.

1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one.  Although I have many names, I answer to few.  But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1297|ed056522.name: Lina Stover
1297|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1297|fe52f4ea.name: Lina Stover
1297|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1312|0624ab70.name: Ardwyn Cailen
1312|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1315|23d8b931.name: Allan Hafgan
1315|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1632|cf99ed46.name: Adele Fielder
1632|cf99ed46.text: Gosh, I'm sorry. I don't have anything new to teach you. How about you go talk to Simon Tanner in the Old Town section of Stormwind? He's a $r with big muscles and dreamy red hair.

16458|41276936.name: Innkeeper Faralia
16458|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

16458|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Faralia
16458|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

198|9c6df40b.name: Khelden Bremen
198|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

2126|db7f8bbb.name: Maximillion
2126|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

2127|db7f8bbb.name: Rupert Boch
2127|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2210|47eae910.name: Deathguard Royann
2210|47eae910.text: We don't have a bank here in Brill, you'll have to go to the Undercity for that.  At the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south are elevators that will take you down into the Undercity.  Once there ask one of the Undercity Guardians for more precise directions.

2210|8a7ec9f6.name: Deathguard Royann
2210|8a7ec9f6.text: It is Bowen Brisboise that you seek then.  You'll find him inside his house southwest of Brill just on the other side of the bridge at Cold Hearth Manor.

2367|279d82d3.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

244808|942bf955.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|942bf955.text: You may not be a paladin, but you may yet find solace in the light should you seek it.

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

247226|58a0ba23.name: Kelsey Fargo
247226|58a0ba23.text: Blast these kobolds. I can't get any work done with them running back and forth, getting in my way. Well, I've got nothing better to do, would you like to learn about mining techniques? Or perhaps you just need some new tools?

247229|55b52cc4.name: Daniel
247229|55b52cc4.text: What does Brother Paxton need now?

248415|bdfaa98c.name: Tordrin Sternblade
248415|bdfaa98c.text: I heard ol' Marshal McBride was sendin' ye' my way.

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

267279|83e0509a.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

276316|1b05d5c3.name: Raul Sweete
276316|1b05d5c3.text:
If ye want to see the elven port of Auberdine and all its mysterious mist, you've come to the right dock. If ye also want to see the beauty and glory of Menethil Harbor, even better--same ship'll take ye there, too!

It ain't a journey for the weak, but if you've got the spirit of adventure in yer gullet then yer in luck!

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3523|02cc6c56.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|02cc6c56.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. May I help you?

3523|a670d938.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|a670d938.text: So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4217|54c391c0.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|54c391c0.text: What brings you to the Cenarion Circle, $N?

4258|965533ff.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|965533ff.text: Welcome to the Great Forge lad. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4974|e9a7b43b.name: Aldwin Laughlin
4974|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

5127|dd957ca2.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|dd957ca2.text: Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!

514|ca5296f2.name: Smith Argus
514|ca5296f2.text: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

5164|105bb6dd.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|105bb6dd.text: Ye bothered me for that? Ye'd be better off strapping a dead rabbit to yer back and running through a Troll's den than wearing that piece of garbage.

5193|e9a7b43b.name: Rebecca Laughlin
5193|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5695|0a25fc55.name: Vance Undergloom
5695|0a25fc55.text: Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

5749|721fd095.name: Kayla Smithe
5749|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|94dfc58d.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|94dfc58d.text:
A $C is it?  Well, then you will want to speak with Thorfin Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.  

Oh, and you be sure to tell him that if I step in his pet's business one more time, he's going to be training other hunters from behind bars in the Stockade!

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|c66ddc75.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|c66ddc75.text: Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

8738|f3c8f530.name: Vazario Linkgrease
8738|f3c8f530.text: Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

915|a0b51800.name: Jorik Kerridan
915|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1057-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-accept.text:
As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.

You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.

The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.

Drive the wretched harpies out, $N!
1057-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

118-accept.name: Verner Osgood
118-accept.text:
I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
118-accept.title: The Price of Shoes

118-complete.name: Smith Argus
118-complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
118-complete.title: The Price of Shoes

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-accept.name: Smith Argus
119-accept.text:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
119-accept.title: Return to Verner

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

120-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
120-accept.text:
These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. 

Now make haste!
120-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

124-complete.name: Verner Osgood
124-complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.
124-complete.title: A Baying of Gnolls

125-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
125-accept.text:
I could really use a hand here, $N.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

Retrieve my toolbox, $N, and I'll make it worth your while.
125-accept.title: The Lost Tools

126-accept.name: Verner Osgood
126-accept.text:
$N, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
126-accept.title: Howling in the Hills

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

127-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-accept.text:
Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
127-accept.title: Selling Fish

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

129-accept.name: Darcy
129-accept.text:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
129-accept.title: A Free Lunch

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

139-complete.name: Unknown
139-complete.text: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!
139-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

140-accept.name: Unknown
140-accept.text: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sander's treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
140-accept.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

140-complete.name: Unknown
140-complete.text:
The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work.  You force the chest open and take the booty.

Congratulations!
140-complete.title: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure

1470-accept.name: Venya Marthand
1470-accept.text:
Greetings, child. I can see that you are still young in the ways of the $c, power still eluding your grasp. I can sense your eagerness to learn.

And you will learn.

There is no strength in ignorance. Knowledge is our greatest power. Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.

I will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.
1470-accept.title: Piercing the Veil

1470-complete.name: Venya Marthand
1470-complete.text:
Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.

Attend me carefully, $N, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.
1470-complete.title: Piercing the Veil

1470-progress.name: Venya Marthand
1470-progress.text:
Your power is little now, though I suspect already you sense the possibilities.

Even the dead might feel alive, with that power coursing through us.
1470-progress.title: Piercing the Veil

1486-complete.name: Nalpak
1486-complete.text:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, $N.

Thank you for your dedication.
1486-complete.title: Deviate Hides

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

1487-complete.name: Ebru
1487-complete.text:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, $N.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.
1487-complete.title: Deviate Eradication

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

15-complete.name: Marshal McBride
15-complete.text: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine.  No good can come of this.  Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again.  I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
15-complete.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

150-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-accept.text:
Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!

Hunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
150-accept.title: Murloc Poachers

1578-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1578-accept.text:
The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it!  They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear.  So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged.  He might even share his knowledge with you.

Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
1578-accept.title: Supplying the Front

163-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
163-accept.text:
Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $N. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
163-accept.title: Raven Hill

164-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
164-accept.text:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
164-accept.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
165-accept.text: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
165-accept.title: The Hermit

169-accept.name: Unknown
169-accept.text:
Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. 

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
169-accept.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-complete.name: Deputy Willem
18-complete.text: Back with some bandanas, I see.  The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
18-complete.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

180-accept.name: Unknown
180-accept.text:
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore

Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
180-accept.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-accept.name: Marshal Marris
19-accept.text: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
19-accept.title: Tharil'zun

20-accept.name: Marshal Marris
20-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

Help rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.

And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
20-accept.title: Blackrock Menace

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

21-accept.name: Marshal McBride
21-accept.text:
Your previous investigations are proof that the Echo Ridge Mine needs purging.  Return to the mine and help clear it of kobolds.

Waste no time, $N.  The longer the kobolds are left unmolested in the mine, the deeper a foothold they gain in Northshire.
21-accept.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

21-complete.name: Marshal McBride
21-complete.text: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army.  There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them.  We have further tasks for you.
21-complete.title: Skirmish at Echo Ridge

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

279-complete.name: Karl Boran
279-complete.text:
Ah, well done $N.

Accept this as payment for fulfillment of your contract with the Merchant Marines.
279-complete.title: Claws from the Deep

279-progress.name: Karl Boran
279-progress.text: Our merchants will not be safe until we are rid of Gobbler and those Murlocs.
279-progress.title: Claws from the Deep

281-accept.name: Karl Boran
281-accept.text:
Not long ago a merchant vessel, the Blind Princess, was raided by Murlocs.  Although the ship escaped intact, much of its cargo was dragged overboard by the creatures, including a very valuable statuette of Terenas Menethil.  We want that statuette recovered.

Search the coastal Murloc hovels for crates, barrels and other evidence of lost cargo.  Find the Menethil Statuette and return it to me.
281-accept.title: Reclaiming Goods

3099-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3099-accept.text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the $c trainer Maximillion. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
3099-accept.title: Tainted Scroll

3099-complete.name: Maximillion
3099-complete.text:
I mentioned a slave still being a slave, no matter the master. Do you remember? We both know that it is that type of control--that type of power--that now drives us. We seek to have creatures serve us. We know we are more powerful and deserve more respect than others give us ... and so now we look to take it.

I will be your ally in this struggle--the struggle for our own freedom. Freedom to seek our own allegiances. When you feel ready, return to me and I will teach you all I know.
3099-complete.title: Tainted Scroll

3099-progress.name: Maximillion
3099-progress.text:
I bid you welcome, brother. I knew you would come. It was only a matter of time.

What I said interested you, didn't it? I hit a chord... something inside you knew what I claimed was truth. Good.

Know this though: I am no traitor to Sylvanas. If anything, she would appreciate my claims considering it was her own beliefs that has put the Forsaken in the position it is now.
3099-progress.title: Tainted Scroll

3102-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3102-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Jorik, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3102-accept.title: Encrypted Letter

3102-complete.name: Jorik Kerridan
3102-complete.text:
You're gonna find a number of outfits that covet our skills, $N. Adventurers, SI:7... heck, even the Defias Brotherhood wouldn't mind a spy or two inside Stormwind. But you remember this, you're your own man. Don't let nobody bully you into doing something you don't wanna do! Besides, we hold all the cards... at least, we do before the game's done. Know what I mean?

Anyway, just wanted to introduce myself and let you know that I'm here if you need any training. Come by anytime.
3102-complete.title: Encrypted Letter

3102-progress.name: Jorik Kerridan
3102-progress.text:
You made it here in one piece, and it doesn't look like too many people saw you. Good enough for me. I don't like to have much attention drawn to me back here... nice and quiet. I'm sure you can understand.

Have any trouble yet? I'm glad to hear not. That'll change soon enough.
3102-progress.title: Encrypted Letter

3104-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3104-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local $c trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3104-accept.title: Glyphic Letter

3104-complete.name: Khelden Bremen
3104-complete.text:
Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?

I will not lie, $N, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.
3104-complete.title: Glyphic Letter

3104-progress.name: Khelden Bremen
3104-progress.text: Hello, $N. I am Khelden. Is there something I can do for you?
3104-progress.title: Glyphic Letter

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3370-accept.name: Falla Sagewind
3370-accept.text:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, $N, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can... 

Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Circle is who you need to find. Head to Darnassus. I cannot say more.
3370-accept.title: In Nightmares

3370-complete.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
3370-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Mathrengyl peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that the Cenarion druids alone must attend to.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3370-complete.title: In Nightmares

3370-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
3370-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3370-progress.title: In Nightmares

34-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
34-accept.text:
Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
34-accept.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
34-complete.text: Finally the menace is laid to rest!  Thank you, $N, you have done me a great service.  The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
34-complete.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

363-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
363-complete.text:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
363-complete.title: Rude Awakening

364-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-accept.text:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the $r, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
364-accept.title: The Mindless Ones

364-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-complete.text:
It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.

But they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
364-complete.title: The Mindless Ones

367-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has called upon the Royal Apothecary Society. The Dark Lady believes our knowledge coupled with the newfound magic will provide the key to Arthas's demise.  She has challenged us to concoct a new plague, a plague deadlier than any ailment on Azeroth. This new disease will bring Arthas's Scourge Army to ruin.

My studies show that the blood of beasts might prove to be the key. Bring to me 5 vials of darkhound blood so I can test my theory.
367-accept.title: A New Plague

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

3741-accept.name: Shawn
3741-accept.text:
My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.

Could you find it for her, please?
3741-accept.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-complete.name: Hilary
3741-complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace mister $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
3741-complete.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

375-accept.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-accept.text:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, $N, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
375-accept.title: The Chill of Death

376-accept.name: Novice Elreth
376-accept.text:
My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.

From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
376-accept.title: The Damned

376-complete.name: Novice Elreth
376-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. This armor should help you out.

Hopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
376-complete.title: The Damned

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

380-accept.name: Executor Arren
380-accept.text:
One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the Alliance's power.

There is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.

Get up there and see what you can do for us, $N.
380-accept.title: Night Web's Hollow

380-complete.name: Executor Arren
380-complete.text:
Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.

You've done your duty well, $N, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
380-complete.title: Night Web's Hollow

381-accept.name: Executor Arren
381-accept.text:
You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts.  We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every $r--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
381-accept.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-complete.name: Executor Arren
381-complete.text:
If only they listened to reason, eh, $N? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!

Light-blinded fools.
381-complete.title: The Scarlet Crusade

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

382-accept.name: Executor Arren
382-accept.text:
Reports from my superiors in Brill indicate that an agent of the Scarlet Crusade was dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!

You're the most qualified person I have to send, $N. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
382-accept.title: The Red Messenger

382-complete.name: Executor Arren
382-complete.text:
Hmm... Let's see what you've got...

<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>

Some news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
382-complete.title: The Red Messenger

383-accept.name: Executor Arren
383-accept.text:
These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.

Take the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
383-accept.title: Vital Intelligence

383-complete.name: Executor Zygand
383-complete.text:
Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, $N. Hmm... names of the officers in the Tirisfal Glades...

Imagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
383-complete.title: Vital Intelligence

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

3901-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3901-accept.text:
You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances $N - now let's see you under pressure.

The Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far.  Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken.  Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
3901-accept.title: Rattling the Rattlecages

3901-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3901-complete.text:
I am finished with you, $N - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given.  Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.

Take these and be on your way.  You have much to accomplish, $c.
3901-complete.title: Rattling the Rattlecages

3902-accept.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-accept.text:
You there!  If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

We need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment.  Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes.  We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!

Well get to work, you miserable bag of bones!  I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
3902-accept.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-complete.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-complete.text: Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless.  Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
3902-complete.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

398-accept.name: Unknown
398-accept.text:
Wanted: Maggot Eye!

A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken.  This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army.  Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.

The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution.  Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.

Mercy is for the weak.
398-accept.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

404-accept.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-accept.text:
Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.

Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find.  Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.
404-accept.title: A Putrid Task

427-accept.name: Executor Zygand
427-accept.text:
The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade.  We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.

But the Deathguard has larger concerns.  The Lich King's army grows in number each night.  We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.

Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.
427-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

463-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
463-complete.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one.  Although I have many names, I answer to only a few.  But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.
463-complete.title: The Greenwarden

467-accept.name: Pilot Longbeard
467-accept.text:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
467-accept.title: Stonegear's Search

47-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-accept.text:
The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them.  I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town!

You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
47-accept.title: Gold Dust Exchange

471-accept.name: James Halloran
471-accept.text:
I sent my apprentice out into the marshes to skin some of our famous giant Wetlands crocolisks. When he didn't return, I went out to look for him... Let's just say it wasn't a pretty sight.

Midwife says he might pull through, but in the meantime I still need my skins!

...If you'd like to kill a few more of the brutes, I wouldn't be opposed, after what they did. You'll find the crocs north up the coast, beyond the murloc hovels.
471-accept.title: Apprentice's Duties

484-complete.name: James Halloran
484-complete.text: Nice work you've done here, $N. The quality of these skins is superb. I'll have to get them into the curing process as soon as possible. Oh, but before I get to that, there's some other work I need done that I think you might be able to take care of.
484-complete.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-complete.name: Deputy Willem
6-complete.text: Hah - you caught him!  You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
6-complete.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-accept.name: William Pestle
60-accept.text:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
60-accept.title: Kobold Candles

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6395-accept.name: Novice Elreth
6395-accept.text:
My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.

Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband.  So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.

Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell.  Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
6395-accept.title: Marla's Last Wish

6395-complete.name: Novice Elreth
6395-complete.text: You have done a good deed today, $N.  Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place. As a token of my gratitude, please take one of these manuals I found.
6395-complete.title: Marla's Last Wish

6981-accept.name: Unknown
6981-accept.text:
The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
6981-accept.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-complete.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-complete.text: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
6981-complete.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

78143-complete.name: Garion Wendell
78143-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78143-complete.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

78143-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78143-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143-progress.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79091-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79091-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. You say this is from the Ironforge library? ...I'm sure they won't miss it.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79091-complete.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

79091-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79091-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79091-progress.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

79097-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79097-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79097-complete.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

79097-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79097-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097-progress.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

79192-complete.name: Unknown
79192-complete.text: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
79192-complete.title: Stepping Stones

79974-accept.name: Unknown
79974-accept.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974-accept.title: Wet Job

79975-accept.name: Unknown
79975-accept.text:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975-accept.title: Eagle's Fist

79975-complete.name: Unknown
79975-complete.text: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
79975-complete.title: Eagle's Fist

79976-accept.name: Unknown
79976-accept.text:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976-accept.title: This Must Be The Place

79976-complete.name: Unknown
79976-complete.text: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.
79976-complete.title: This Must Be The Place

79980-accept.name: Unknown
79980-accept.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980-accept.title: Scramble

79980-complete.name: Unknown
79980-complete.text: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
79980-complete.title: Scramble

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

86784-accept.name: Deathguard Bartholomew
86784-accept.text:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784-accept.title: Sticks and Bones

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

90-accept.name: Chef Grual
90-accept.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90-accept.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91-accept.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-accept.text:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-accept.title: Solomon's Law

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91741-complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!
